activeQuestion.prompt: What is the main trade-off between the two chamber options?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 兩種測試箱方案主要要取捨什麼？

options.text: Bringing fewer samples or running a shorter test.
options.zh: 少帶一些樣品，或縮短測試時間。
options.whyZh: 兩種方案都沒有提到縮短原定測試時間。

options.text: Testing sooner or fitting all the samples.
options.zh: 提早開始測試，或容納所有樣品。
options.whyZh: 小測試箱週三就能用，但裝不下全部十二件樣品；大測試箱能容納全數，但要等到週五。

options.text: Starting on Friday or getting more time in the same chamber.
options.zh: 週五開始，或延長同一台測試箱的使用時間。
options.whyZh: 提早開始必須改用小測試箱，不是延長同一台的使用時間。

options.text: Keeping the chamber available or changing the test plan.
options.zh: 維持測試箱可用，或修改測試計畫。
options.whyZh: 對話比較的是容量與可用時間，沒有說要修改計畫。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 小測試箱週三就能用，但裝不下全部十二件樣品；大測試箱能容納全數，但要等到週五。
activeQuestion.evidence: Another team has booked it through Thursday. You could begin Friday morning, or use the smaller chamber on Wednesday. | The smaller one cannot hold all twelve samples. Let us choose Friday, and I will notify the project manager about the revised completion date.

vocabulary.note: 選擇一項好處時，必須放棄另一項好處。

originalQuestion.prompt: Why is the requested chamber unavailable on Wednesday?
originalQuestion.promptZh: 星期三為何無法使用所需試驗箱？

options.text: It is being moved to a new building.

options.whyZh: 計畫只被要求帶來，沒有被否決。

options.text: Another team has already booked it.
options.whyZh: 男方說其他團隊的預約持續到星期四。

options.text: The laboratory is closed all week.
options.whyZh: 星期三仍有小試驗箱、星期五有大試驗箱可用。

originalQuestion.explanationZh: 男方說其他團隊的預約持續到星期四。
originalQuestion.evidence: Another team has booked it through Thursday.

vocabulary.note: 本題指預約設備使用時段。
在指定條件下評估產品持續運作等表現，具體條件由測試計畫定義。

group.title: Rescheduling a reliability test
group.passage:
Woman: We need the reliability chamber for three days, starting Wednesday. Is it available?
Man: Another team has booked it through Thursday. You could begin Friday morning, or use the smaller chamber on Wednesday.
Woman: The smaller one cannot hold all twelve samples. Let us choose Friday, and I will notify the project manager about the revised completion date.
Man: I will reserve the larger chamber for you. Please bring the test plan when you check in.
group.passageZh:
女：我們從星期三開始需要使用可靠度試驗箱三天。有空檔嗎？
男：另一個團隊已預約到星期四，包含星期四當天。你們可以星期五早上開始，或星期三用比較小的試驗箱。
女：小的那台放不下全部十二個樣品。我們選星期五，我會通知專案經理修改後的完成日期。
男：我會替你預約較大的試驗箱。登記使用時請帶測試計畫。
